proposed_dependency_order.invariant: The same focal material body undergoes coordinated bodily movements constituting a locomotor activity pattern. Actual displacement of the whole body relative to the surroundings, intention and a destination are not required.
proposed_dependency_order.conventional_addition: Locomotor activity pattern and identity of its actor with the focal material bearer.
excludes: machine operation inferred from energized material

proposed_dependency_order.invariant: The same actor performs a running gait, including its grounded forms and in-place execution. No particular speed, universal airborne interval, destination or completed displacement is asserted.
proposed_dependency_order.definition_work_remaining: Specify the gait-class convention and contrasts without a circular English-only alias or human-only mechanical criterion.

proposed_dependency_order.invariant: The same actor performs coordinated bodily movements that generate swimming propulsion against surrounding water. Passive carriage in water does not suffice. Ground-relative arrival or net journey completion is not asserted.
proposed_dependency_order.definition_work_remaining: Specify medium binding, assisted swimming boundaries, and station-holding relative frames.

acceptance_cases.input: Nora is running toward the gate.
Eli is swimming across the river.
Eli is running and Nora is swimming.
